name: TA-7-low-confidence-penalize
why: The same low-confidence cell as TA-7-low-confidence-block, but under unknownPolicy penalize the cell is eligible again (eligibleCount 25 vs. 24) rather than hard-excluded — the support-cost penalty on its two edges here still outweighs the shorter diagonal, so the found route happens to match the block case, which is itself the point: penalize changes what the search is ALLOWED to use, not merely which specific route the detour-vs-shortcut trade happens to favour on this grid.
